raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Rebased onto `develop` after #1652 (the block-sparse decode block) merged as `4c4102651`: the diff is this PR's own files -- the cast kernel and its test
module, the block and its e4m3 test module, the layout pin's absent set, the append-only execute-signature pin, the doc page, the tracker and the API-index row.

## What

The serving stacks' `--kv-cache-dtype fp8` recipe on the gated attention block, as ONE declaration attribute, `kv_cache_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn` (default `None` = the activation dtype: the bf16 / f16 pools as before), with the pools' per-tensor fp32 DEscales at execute, `k_scale` / `v_scale` (1-element CUDA tensors read on device; value = code x scale).  A bf16 Q over an e4m3 pool only -- an fp8 Q is a different function (the per-tensor FP8 SDPA rows take e4m3 Q / K / V together) and is not a form of this block.  No new kernel.

* **The write-through quantizes.**  Under the attribute the post-RoPE K / V rows go into the e4m3 pools as `sat_e4m3(row x (1 / scale))`: two launches of the FP8 pipeline's per-tensor cast (`kernels/quantize.py`, the slab band / the compact buffer as the source, two compact e4m3 workspace slots as the destination) and one launch of the existing cache write copying those rows BITWISE through the pools' bf16 views (an e4m3 `[.., D]` row is a bf16 `[.., D / 2]` row over the same bytes; every pool stride is a whole number of 16-byte vectors, so HND / NHD / unified-row pools bind alike).  The reciprocals of the caller's scales are two fp32 words of the workspace written by `torch.reciprocal(..., out=)` on the launch stream (capture-safe, no allocation, no host read).  The raw indexer key keeps its bf16 pool.  Served on the dense prefill forms over the block's own K / V (a `QsaSpec` or a dense geometry); `out` is bitwise the bf16-pool block's.
* **The block-sparse decode step reads e4m3 pools** (`kv_source="paged"` on a dense `[B, S_q <= 4]` `QsaSpec` declaration -- the shared-list form of #1652).  Stage (4) becomes `kernels/qsa_kv_upcast.py` + the Rubin d256 decode tile: the cast gathers, per (token, KV head) item, the sequence's listed 4-token blocks and the open tail over `[0, kv_lens[b])` through `block_table[b]` on the bottom-right diagonal, dequantizes each row (`bf16(fp32(code) x scale)`) and writes the visible rows compacted in list order into the workspace scratch `[B x S_q x H_kv, 2, 2176, 256]` plus a per-item length (0 = a dead item; every row past the length 0.0); the decode tile then runs over that scratch as a plain padded dense SDPA -- Q per item `[items, G, 1, D]` (a view of the COMPACT normed Q, which is why the mode norms + rotates out of place), K / V the scratch halves `[items, 1, 2176, D]`, no causal mask (the gathered rows are the visible set), the length on the KV side only, the group packed, unsplit; the compiled template is pinned to `decode_d256_f16` at compile.  The gate runs as its own launch.  The sparse core is untouched by fp8.
* **The cast kernel lands here** (`kernels/qsa_kv_upcast.py` + `test_qsa_kv_upcast.py`): a persistent grid of 4-warp CTAs over (item, 32-slot) units, one warp per 4-row block, 16-byte e4m3 loads, `cvt.rn.bf16x2.e4m3x2` -> `cvt.f32.bf16` -> `mul.f32x2` -> `cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32`, two 16-byte stores per operand per row; no shared memory, no mbarrier.  Its own module pins the cast bitwise a torch cast through the compaction contract, cast + the decode tile vs the oracle on the dequantized pool, the 128-bit row-traffic SASS and the typed declines.
* **The workspace** appends `kc8` / `vc8` / `kv_inv` and, on the decode mode, `kv_gathered` / `kv_len_t` at the end of the carve; every layout without the attribute is byte-identical to before (the layout pin test extends its absent set by the five slots).  `get_workspace_size()` holds the scratch (2.2 MB per item at d256).
* **Typed declines**, each pinned: `torch.float8_e5m2` (by name) and any other dtype; the attribute without `paged_kv_page_size`; `quant` / `save_for_backward` with it (the write-through's rows speak); f16 activations; over the pools the EXTEND form and the dense DECODE form (the paged THD body and the decode tile read bf16 / f16 pools: a dense e4m3 pool needs the tile's in-kernel dequant arm -- a follow-up), `S_q > 4` (the per-token list form would gather 2.2 MB of scratch per item), `return_lse` (the tile over the scratch writes item-major Stats), `decode_split_kv > 1` (unsplit over at most 17 KV tiles per item), `fuse_norm_rope` and an explicit `inplace_qkv=True` (the per-item Q is a view of the compact Q alone); the packed prefill's quantizing write-through (its accept cell is owed); pools of the wrong dtype at declaration and at execute, both ways; the scales missing under the attribute or given without it.  `serving_envelope(...).decode.kv_cache_dtypes` (appended) names the pool dtypes served per geometry / dtype.
* **Append-only**: `kv_cache_dtype` is the last constructor argument, `k_scale` / `v_scale` the last `execute` arguments; `DecodeEnvelope.kv_cache_dtypes` and the five `_Intermediates` slots default to their absent values.
* **The write-through fold composes with the cache by staying off.**  `fuse_cache_write` (None = AUTO: the paged write-through folded into the fused
  norm + RoPE projection's epilogue) writes 16-bit rows, and this cache's write-through quantizes -- so AUTO never folds under the attribute (the
  separate quantizing launches stay) and an explicit `True` is a typed decline naming both attributes.  Found when this branch met the fold on
  `develop`; pinned RED-first (a `fuse_norm_rope=True` e4m3 declaration reads `cache_write_fused` False with the quantizing stage and the fork's pool
  arm unarmed, the same declaration over 16-bit pools folds, the explicit `True` declines).  The append-only pin on `execute` now reads
  `num_tokens_live`, then `k_scale` / `v_scale` last.

## Tests

`test/python/gated_attention_block/cutedsl/test_block_qsa_fp8_kv.py` (L0; RED on the unchanged tree -- an import error of the new names, then every declaration cell): on any device the declaration facts and the carve (the two e4m3 stages, the forced out-of-place norm, the gate as its own launch, the split 1, the appended slots, the stage order, the write-through-only declaration), the typed declines, the execute-time form checks under `set_sync_debug_mode("error")`, the envelope; on Rubin (cc 10.7, a development node, 204 SMs; functional only) the decode ladder vs the fp32 oracle ON THE DEQUANTIZED POOL -- the prefix rows quantized by torch with the per-tensor scales (`amax / 448`), the step rows the block's own quantizing write; `S_q` 1 .. 4, B 1 / 3 / 4, `kv_lens` up to 20000 with a dead entry and a sequence shorter than the step, pages 16 / 32 / 64 on HND / unified / NHD pools, `block_lens` given / absent, the gate fused (= its own launch here) and separate, the indexer band's raw-key write-through, the 24 / 2 Flash-Next geometry; the MTP residues on ~60-token sequences; the write-through-only prefill form (`out` BITWISE the bf16-pool twin's, the pools BITWISE the torch cast, padded slots unwritten); the packed prefill with the attribute DECLINED by name (a review found the constructor accepting the form the docs call a typed decline; the same packing over bf16 pools served); `get_workspace_size()` honest (a sentinel past it untouched, every scratch row past an item's length 0.0, the inverse scales as written); CUDA-graph capture of the FIRST execute on a new stream with no warm-up replaying bitwise eager, and the replay over new scales / lengths / tables / lists / slots / inputs bitwise the eager run over them.

Margins on Rubin: the gated O within 2.4e-4 .. 3.9e-3 of the dequantized-pool oracle (budget 2e-2, the sparse module's bar, unchanged), `cos(out) >= 0.999995`, dead rows exactly 0, the pools' step rows bitwise torch's `(row.float() * (1 / scale)).clamp(-448, 448).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)`; the distance to the pre-quantization bf16 oracle 1.3e-3 .. 3.1e-2 (reported without a gate: the recipe's own rounding).  `test_qsa_kv_upcast.py` 11 passed on the same node; the fp8 dead-entry pin of `test_block_fp8.py`, the decode module, the two QSA block modules and the three serving modules green on the branch's `api.py`; the host tier (A100) of the new, the layout-pin and the neighbouring modules green.  At the head rebased onto `develop` (the fused write-through and the live-token count under it), re-run: on Rubin the e4m3 module
19 passed, the cast module 11, the decode module 32, the two QSA block modules 124, the three serving modules 177 (the fold's and the
live-count cells beside this cache); on the host 395 passed / 534 skipped / 0 failed (the new, cast, layout-pin, decode, QSA block and serving
modules + the tier lists).  The API index gains the one row the appended envelope field adds (`DecodeEnvelope.kv_cache_dtypes`).
The cast kernel's test module gates the DSL floor before it imports the kernel, so a release-DSL lane (4.6.2, no `cutlass.experimental`)
skips it with the version named instead of erroring at collection; the e4m3 write takes the live-row views like the bf16 write.

## Docs

`docs/fe-oss-apis/gated_attention_block.md`: the contract page's `kv_cache_dtype` row and the `k_scale` / `v_scale` mapping row, a "Serving: the e4m3 KV cache" section, the API block, the limits.  `SUPPORT_MATRIX_TRACKER.md`: the gaps row, the not-served sentence and a "Served since 2026-10-14 -- the e4m3 KV cache" paragraph with its cell table.

## Performance

None claimed (functional cells only).  The unfused e4m3 decode step runs 9 device launches against the bf16 decode mode's 5 (the projection, norm + RoPE out of place, two casts, the cache write, the gathered cast, the decode tile, the gate, the out projection) plus two `torch.reciprocal` ops; the levers a later change measures: the quantizing write inside the projection epilogue, the reciprocal inside the write kernel, the in-kernel dequant.

## Open

* The dense DECODE / EXTEND forms over e4m3 pools (the decode tile's and the paged THD body's in-kernel dequant arm).
* The packed prefill's quantizing write-through (the same token-addressed launches; its accept cell).
* `S_q > 4` (the per-token list form), the LSE and a split over e4m3 pools.
* f16 activations over an e4m3 cache.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

* **Limitations**
  * e4m3 cache support is limited to the documented prefill and sparse decode forms; unsupported configurations are rejected.

detail.body:
Rebased onto `develop` after #1652 (the block-sparse decode block) merged as `4c4102651`: the diff is this PR's own files -- the cast kernel and its test
module, the block and its e4m3 test module, the layout pin's absent set, the append-only execute-signature pin, the doc page, the tracker and the API-index row.

## What

The serving stacks' `--kv-cache-dtype fp8` recipe on the gated attention block, as ONE declaration attribute, `kv_cache_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn` (default `None` = the activation dtype: the bf16 / f16 pools as before), with the pools' per-tensor fp32 DEscales at execute, `k_scale` / `v_scale` (1-element CUDA tensors read on device; value = code x scale).  A bf16 Q over an e4m3 pool only -- an fp8 Q is a different function (the per-tensor FP8 SDPA rows take e4m3 Q / K / V together) and is not a form of this block.  No new kernel.

* **The write-through quantizes.**  Under the attribute the post-RoPE K / V rows go into the e4m3 pools as `sat_e4m3(row x (1 / scale))`: two launches of the FP8 pipeline's per-tensor cast (`kernels/quantize.py`, the slab band / the compact buffer as the source, two compact e4m3 workspace slots as the destination) and one launch of the existing cache write copying those rows BITWISE through the pools' bf16 views (an e4m3 `[.., D]` row is a bf16 `[.., D / 2]` row over the same bytes; every pool stride is a whole number of 16-byte vectors, so HND / NHD / unified-row pools bind alike).  The reciprocals of the caller's scales are two fp32 words of the workspace written by `torch.reciprocal(..., out=)` on the launch stream (capture-safe, no allocation, no host read).  The raw indexer key keeps its bf16 pool.  Served on the dense prefill forms over the block's own K / V (a `QsaSpec` or a dense geometry); `out` is bitwise the bf16-pool block's.
* **The block-sparse decode step reads e4m3 pools** (`kv_source="paged"` on a dense `[B, S_q <= 4]` `QsaSpec` declaration -- the shared-list form of #1652).  Stage (4) becomes `kernels/qsa_kv_upcast.py` + the Rubin d256 decode tile: the cast gathers, per (token, KV head) item, the sequence's listed 4-token blocks and the open tail over `[0, kv_lens[b])` through `block_table[b]` on the bottom-right diagonal, dequantizes each row (`bf16(fp32(code) x scale)`) and writes the visible rows compacted in list order into the workspace scratch `[B x S_q x H_kv, 2, 2176, 256]` plus a per-item length (0 = a dead item; every row past the length 0.0); the decode tile then runs over that scratch as a plain padded dense SDPA -- Q per item `[items, G, 1, D]` (a view of the COMPACT normed Q, which is why the mode norms + rotates out of place), K / V the scratch halves `[items, 1, 2176, D]`, no causal mask (the gathered rows are the visible set), the length on the KV side only, the group packed, unsplit; the compiled template is pinned to `decode_d256_f16` at compile.  The gate runs as its own launch.  The sparse core is untouched by fp8.
* **The cast kernel lands here** (`kernels/qsa_kv_upcast.py` + `test_qsa_kv_upcast.py`): a persistent grid of 4-warp CTAs over (item, 32-slot) units, one warp per 4-row block, 16-byte e4m3 loads, `cvt.rn.bf16x2.e4m3x2` -> `cvt.f32.bf16` -> `mul.f32x2` -> `cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32`, two 16-byte stores per operand per row; no shared memory, no mbarrier.  Its own module pins the cast bitwise a torch cast through the compaction contract, cast + the decode tile vs the oracle on the dequantized pool, the 128-bit row-traffic SASS and the typed declines.
* **The workspace** appends `kc8` / `vc8` / `kv_inv` and, on the decode mode, `kv_gathered` / `kv_len_t` at the end of the carve; every layout without the attribute is byte-identical to before (the layout pin test extends its absent set by the five slots).  `get_workspace_size()` holds the scratch (2.2 MB per item at d256).
* **Typed declines**, each pinned: `torch.float8_e5m2` (by name) and any other dtype; the attribute without `paged_kv_page_size`; `quant` / `save_for_backward` with it (the write-through's rows speak); f16 activations; over the pools the EXTEND form and the dense DECODE form (the paged THD body and the decode tile read bf16 / f16 pools: a dense e4m3 pool needs the tile's in-kernel dequant arm -- a follow-up), `S_q > 4` (the per-token list form would gather 2.2 MB of scratch per item), `return_lse` (the tile over the scratch writes item-major Stats), `decode_split_kv > 1` (unsplit over at most 17 KV tiles per item), `fuse_norm_rope` and an explicit `inplace_qkv=True` (the per-item Q is a view of the compact Q alone); the packed prefill's quantizing write-through (its accept cell is owed); pools of the wrong dtype at declaration and at execute, both ways; the scales missing under the attribute or given without it.  `serving_envelope(...).decode.kv_cache_dtypes` (appended) names the pool dtypes served per geometry / dtype.
* **Append-only**: `kv_cache_dtype` is the last constructor argument, `k_scale` / `v_scale` the last `execute` arguments; `DecodeEnvelope.kv_cache_dtypes` and the five `_Intermediates` slots default to their absent values.
* **The write-through fold composes with the cache by staying off.**  `fuse_cache_write` (None = AUTO: the paged write-through folded into the fused
  norm + RoPE projection's epilogue) writes 16-bit rows, and this cache's write-through quantizes -- so AUTO never folds under the attribute (the
  separate quantizing launches stay) and an explicit `True` is a typed decline naming both attributes.  Found when this branch met the fold on
  `develop`; pinned RED-first (a `fuse_norm_rope=True` e4m3 declaration reads `cache_write_fused` False with the quantizing stage and the fork's pool
  arm unarmed, the same declaration over 16-bit pools folds, the explicit `True` declines).  The append-only pin on `execute` now reads
  `num_tokens_live`, then `k_scale` / `v_scale` last.

## Tests

`test/python/gated_attention_block/cutedsl/test_block_qsa_fp8_kv.py` (L0; RED on the unchanged tree -- an import error of the new names, then every declaration cell): on any device the declaration facts and the carve (the two e4m3 stages, the forced out-of-place norm, the gate as its own launch, the split 1, the appended slots, the stage order, the write-through-only declaration), the typed declines, the execute-time form checks under `set_sync_debug_mode("error")`, the envelope; on Rubin (cc 10.7, a development node, 204 SMs; functional only) the decode ladder vs the fp32 oracle ON THE DEQUANTIZED POOL -- the prefix rows quantized by torch with the per-tensor scales (`amax / 448`), the step rows the block's own quantizing write; `S_q` 1 .. 4, B 1 / 3 / 4, `kv_lens` up to 20000 with a dead entry and a sequence shorter than the step, pages 16 / 32 / 64 on HND / unified / NHD pools, `block_lens` given / absent, the gate fused (= its own launch here) and separate, the indexer band's raw-key write-through, the 24 / 2 Flash-Next geometry; the MTP residues on ~60-token sequences; the write-through-only prefill form (`out` BITWISE the bf16-pool twin's, the pools BITWISE the torch cast, padded slots unwritten); the packed prefill with the attribute DECLINED by name (a review found the constructor accepting the form the docs call a typed decline; the same packing over bf16 pools served); `get_workspace_size()` honest (a sentinel past it untouched, every scratch row past an item's length 0.0, the inverse scales as written); CUDA-graph capture of the FIRST execute on a new stream with no warm-up replaying bitwise eager, and the replay over new scales / lengths / tables / lists / slots / inputs bitwise the eager run over them.

Margins on Rubin: the gated O within 2.4e-4 .. 3.9e-3 of the dequantized-pool oracle (budget 2e-2, the sparse module's bar, unchanged), `cos(out) >= 0.999995`, dead rows exactly 0, the pools' step rows bitwise torch's `(row.float() * (1 / scale)).clamp(-448, 448).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)`; the distance to the pre-quantization bf16 oracle 1.3e-3 .. 3.1e-2 (reported without a gate: the recipe's own rounding).  `test_qsa_kv_upcast.py` 11 passed on the same node; the fp8 dead-entry pin of `test_block_fp8.py`, the decode module, the two QSA block modules and the three serving modules green on the branch's `api.py`; the host tier (A100) of the new, the layout-pin and the neighbouring modules green.  At the head rebased onto `develop` (the fused write-through and the live-token count under it), re-run: on Rubin the e4m3 module
19 passed, the cast module 11, the decode module 32, the two QSA block modules 124, the three serving modules 177 (the fold's and the
live-count cells beside this cache); on the host 395 passed / 534 skipped / 0 failed (the new, cast, layout-pin, decode, QSA block and serving
modules + the tier lists).  The API index gains the one row the appended envelope field adds (`DecodeEnvelope.kv_cache_dtypes`).
The cast kernel's test module gates the DSL floor before it imports the kernel, so a release-DSL lane (4.6.2, no `cutlass.experimental`)
skips it with the version named instead of erroring at collection; the e4m3 write takes the live-row views like the bf16 write.

## Docs

`docs/fe-oss-apis/gated_attention_block.md`: the contract page's `kv_cache_dtype` row and the `k_scale` / `v_scale` mapping row, a "Serving: the e4m3 KV cache" section, the API block, the limits.  `SUPPORT_MATRIX_TRACKER.md`: the gaps row, the not-served sentence and a "Served since 2026-10-14 -- the e4m3 KV cache" paragraph with its cell table.

## Performance

None claimed (functional cells only).  The unfused e4m3 decode step runs 9 device launches against the bf16 decode mode's 5 (the projection, norm + RoPE out of place, two casts, the cache write, the gathered cast, the decode tile, the gate, the out projection) plus two `torch.reciprocal` ops; the levers a later change measures: the quantizing write inside the projection epilogue, the reciprocal inside the write kernel, the in-kernel dequant.

## Open

+"""``qsa_kv_upcast`` -- the e4m3 paged KV pool, GATHERED by a block list and CAST to bf16 into a dense per-item scratch.
+
+The fp8 KV-cache path of the block's sparse attention (Qwen Sparse Attention over a ``--kv-cache-dtype fp8`` pool) in its
+first form: the bf16 sparse core is NOT taught fp8 operands -- a separate bandwidth kernel dequantizes exactly the rows the
+core would gather, lays them out DENSELY in list order, and the bf16 d256 DECODE tile then runs over the scratch as a plain
+padded dense SDPA (one "batch" per item, the item's query-head group as the packed Q rows, ``seq_len_kv = kv_len_t``).
+No sparse code touches fp8 anywhere; the in-kernel upcast is a later, measured decision.
+
+WHAT IT COMPUTES.  A work ITEM is one (query token ``t``, KV head ``h``) pair -- ``item = (b * S_q + s) * H_kv + h`` for
+token ``s`` of sequence ``b`` -- and the kernel writes, per item and per operand (K then V), the item's VISIBLE key rows
+compacted to the front of a ``[ROWS, D]`` bf16 slab plus ``kv_len_t[item]`` = the number of rows written; every row from
+``kv_len_t`` to the end of the slab is ZERO (the default; ``zero_fill="tile"`` zeroes only up to the next 128-row tile, the
+dense core's KV tile, since the core reads nothing past it).  Dequantization is ``bf16(fp32(e4m3) * scale)`` with
+``k_scale`` / ``v_scale`` fp32 device scalars MULTIPLIED IN (vLLM folds ``k_scale`` into the softmax scale and ``v_scale``
+into the output normalizer; here the core sees plain values), one fp32 rounding -- bitwise ``(pool.float() * scale).bfloat16()``.
+
+The visible set is the sparse core's, row for row (``gated_block_qsa_reference.qsa_visible_mask``): the rows sit at the
+END of the sequence (bottom-right: token ``s`` of sequence ``b`` with KV length ``L_b`` is at position ``pos = L_b - S_q + s``),
+``n_vis = min(pos + 1, L_b)`` (``<= 0`` = a DEAD item), and with ``anchor`` = the row's own position (per-token lists
+``block_ids [B, S_q, top_k]``) or the sequence's STEP-0 position ``L_b - S_q`` (``list_per_sequence``: ONE list ``[B, top_k]``
+shared by the ``S_q <= 4`` rows -- the MTP shared-list semantics) and ``n_anchor = min(anchor + 1, L_b)``:
+
+* ``count = min(block_lens[row], top_k, floor(n_anchor / 4))`` entries are READ (``block_lens`` absent: the last two terms);
+* entry ``i < count`` with id ``blk >= 0`` contributes the rows ``[4 blk, 4 blk + 4) ∩ [0, n_vis)`` -- a complete block, or
+  the first ``cnt < 4`` rows of a block that straddles the visible range; a ``-1`` entry (anywhere inside the count) and an
+  entry at or past ``floor((n_vis + 3) / 4)`` contribute NOTHING and no row -- the compaction skips them (a dense re-read of
+  zero-filled rows would score 0, not -inf, and absorb softmax mass: the rows are dropped, not zeroed);
+* then the OPEN TAIL: the rows ``[4 floor(n_anchor / 4), n_vis)`` -- 0..3 tokens per row, up to two blocks under a shared list
+  (the block completed between step 0 and the row stays visible, the row's own token included);
+* in LIST ORDER (the entries first, then the tail): the order of the keys is immaterial to the softmax up to the fp32
+  association the dense core itself chooses; a listed OPEN block or a repeated id is attended TWICE here as in the core (the
+  list contract forbids both; nothing here deduplicates).

+Rows come from the e4m3 PAGE POOLS ``[num_pages, H_kv, page_size, D]`` (HND compact or NHD storage through the strides, the
+cache-write kernel's own view) through ``block_table [B, max_pages]`` int32: ``page_size % 4 == 0`` so a 4-token block never
+straddles a page (ONE table lookup per block); a ``-1`` table entry, a page index past the table or a page at or past the pool
+reads as ZERO rows that are still counted (the sparse core's convention for a dead page).  Lengths, counts and the table
+are DEVICE values (Rule 3): the host validates FORM only.
+
+GEOMETRY (every derived count comes from these constants; ``_validate_geometry`` pins the couplings):

+    BLOCK_SIZE 4, D 256, ROWS 2176 = UNITS_PER_ITEM 17 x ROW_TILE 128 (the dense core's KV tile)

+    max rows written = 4 x 512 + 6 (a shared list's two tail blocks) = 2054 <= ROWS
+    work UNIT (item, c in 0..16): the slots [32 c, 32 c + 32) of the item's list + the zero fill of the slab rows

+@cute.jit
+def _st_global_v4_zero(addr: cutlass.Int64):
+    """A 16-byte zero store; the zero is materialized INSIDE the asm block (an immediate reaching an operand slot is the
+    integer twin of the constant-float ICE)."""
+    nvvm.inline_ptx("{ .reg .b32 z; mov.b32 z, 0; st.global.v4.b32 [$0], {z, z, z, z}; }", read_only_args=[addr])

+@cute.jit

+    """Butterfly sum over the 32 lanes (every lane ends with the total)."""
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        x = x + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(x, 1 << i)

+@cute.jit

+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        d = cutlass.Int32(1 << i)

+    return x

+@cute.kernel
+def frost_qsa_kv_upcast(
+    mPoolK: cute.Tensor,  # [P, H_kv, page_size, D] e4m3; the first three strides symbolic (HND compact or NHD), D contiguous
+    mPoolV: cute.Tensor,
+    mTable: cute.Tensor,  # [B, max_pages] int32, contiguous
+    mIds: cute.Tensor,  # [rows, top_k] int32, contiguous; rows = B (list_per_sequence) or B x S_q

+    mVScale: cute.Tensor,  # [1] fp32

+    top_k: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    page_size: cutlass.Constexpr[int],

+    zero_fill_full: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    use_pdl: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],

+def scratch_shape(n_items: int):
+    """The scratch the kernel fills: ``[items, 2 (K, V), ROWS, D]`` bf16 -- ``scratch[:, 0]`` / ``scratch[:, 1]`` are the
+    ``out_k`` / ``out_v`` operands (their item stride ``2 x ROWS x D``, row stride ``D``)."""
+    return (int(n_items), 2, ROWS, D)

+
+def scratch_bytes(n_items: int) -> int:
+    return 2 * int(n_items) * 2 * ROWS * D

+def dense_core_views(scratch: torch.Tensor, kv_len_t: torch.Tensor):
+    """The views the bf16 d256 DECODE tile consumes over the scratch as a plain PADDED dense SDPA: K / V as ``[items, H_kv' = 1,
+    ROWS, D]`` (BHSD dims over the scratch's storage) and ``seq_len_kv = kv_len_t`` as ``[items, 1, 1, 1]``; the matching Q is
+    :func:`q_items_view`.  Pure views: nothing is copied."""
+    n_items = int(scratch.shape[0])
+    if tuple(scratch.shape) != scratch_shape(n_items) or scratch.dtype != _OUT_DTYPE:

+def compile_qsa_kv_upcast(
+    *,
+    h_kv: int,
+    top_k: int,
+    page_size: int,
+    list_per_sequence: bool,
+    has_block_lens: bool,
+    zero_fill: str = "full",
+    use_pdl: bool = False,
+    device: Optional[int] = None,

+    """Build from SHAPES ALONE (no allocation, no launch).  The DSL / arch gate runs BEFORE the compile (Rule 7): a decline
+    is a ``NotImplementedError`` naming the device and the DSL, never a ``KeyError`` from inside the DSL."""
+    global _FAKE_STREAM
+    validate_params(h_kv=h_kv, top_k=top_k, page_size=page_size, zero_fill=zero_fill)
+    dev = current_device() if device is None else int(device)
+    why = dsl_decline_reason(dev)
+    if why is not None:
+        raise NotImplementedError(why)
+    if _FAKE_STREAM is None:
+        from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+        _FAKE_STREAM = make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=False)
+    key = (int(h_kv), int(top_k), int(page_size), bool(list_per_sequence), bool(has_block_lens), str(zero_fill), bool(use_pdl), dev)
+    if key not in compiled_cache:
+        compiled_cache[key] = cute.compile(
+            qsa_kv_upcast_launch,
+            _fake_pool(h_kv, page_size),
+            _fake_pool(h_kv, page_size),
+            _fake_i32_2d(cute.sym_int()),  # the table: [B, max_pages], both symbolic
+            _fake_i32_2d(int(top_k)),  # the lists: [rows, top_k]
+            _fake_i32_1d() if has_block_lens else None,
+            _fake_i32_1d(),  # kv_lens
+            _fake_f32_scalar(),
+            _fake_f32_scalar(),
+            _fake_out(),
+            _fake_out(),
+            _fake_i32_1d(),  # kv_len_t
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # n_units  ) runtime; the zeros pin the TYPE only
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # n_ctas   )
+            cutlass.Int32(0),  # s_q      )
+            int(h_kv),
+            int(top_k),
+            int(page_size),
+            bool(list_per_sequence),
+            zero_fill == "full",
+            bool(use_pdl),
+            _FAKE_STREAM,
+            options="--enable-tvm-ffi",
+        )

+        compiled=compiled_cache[key],
+        h_kv=int(h_kv),
+        top_k=int(top_k),
+        page_size=int(page_size),
+        list_per_sequence=bool(list_per_sequence),
+        has_block_lens=bool(has_block_lens),
+        zero_fill=str(zero_fill),
+        sm_count=multiprocessor_count(dev),
+        device=dev,

+def _check_i32(t, name, shape, *, device):
+    if not isinstance(t, torch.Tensor) or t.dtype != torch.int32:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be an int32 tensor of shape {shape}, got {getattr(t, 'dtype', type(t).__name__)}")
+    if tuple(int(x) for x in t.shape) != tuple(shape):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must have shape {shape}, got {tuple(t.shape)}")
+    if not t.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be contiguous, got strides {tuple(t.stride())}")
+    if t.device != device:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must live on {device}, got {t.device}")
+
+
+def check_pool(pool: torch.Tensor, name: str, *, h_kv: int, page_size: int, device) -> None:
+    """One e4m3 pool against the kernel's contract (no device read): ``[num_pages >= 1, H_kv, page_size, D]`` with ``D``
+    contiguous, every other stride a whole number of 16-byte vectors, a 16-byte aligned base.  e5m2 is declined BY NAME
+    (``NotImplementedError``): the block's fp8 KV cache is e4m3 (the serving stacks' ``fp8`` = e4m3fn)."""
+    if not isinstance(pool, torch.Tensor):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a [num_pages, {h_kv}, {page_size}, {D}] e4m3 tensor, got {type(pool).__name__}")
+    if pool.dtype == torch.float8_e5m2:
+        raise NotImplementedError(f"{name} is e5m2: qsa_kv_upcast serves e4m3 (float8_e4m3fn) pools only")
+    if pool.dtype != _POOL_DTYPE:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be {_POOL_DTYPE} (the e4m3 KV cache), got {pool.dtype}")
+    if pool.dim() != 4 or tuple(int(x) for x in pool.shape[1:]) != (h_kv, page_size, D) or int(pool.shape[0]) < 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} must be [num_pages >= 1, H_kv={h_kv}, page_size={page_size}, D={D}] (HND compact, or NHD by strides), got {tuple(pool.shape)}"
+        )
+    strides = tuple(int(s) for s in pool.stride())
+    if strides[3] != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be contiguous along D, got strides {strides}")
+    for ax, st in enumerate(strides[:3]):
+        if st % 16:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} stride[{ax}] = {st} bytes must be a multiple of 16 (rows are read in 16-byte vectors)")
+    if pool.data_ptr() % 16:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 16-byte aligned, got data_ptr={pool.data_ptr():#x}")
+    if pool.device != device:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must live on {device}, got {pool.device}")
+
+
+def check_out(out: torch.Tensor, name: str, *, n_items: int, device) -> None:
+    """One bf16 output slab ``[items, ROWS, D]`` with ``D`` contiguous and 16-byte-aligned item / row strides."""
+    if not isinstance(out, torch.Tensor) or out.dtype != _OUT_DTYPE:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a bf16 [{n_items}, {ROWS}, {D}] tensor, got {getattr(out, 'dtype', type(out).__name__)}")
+    if tuple(int(x) for x in out.shape) != (n_items, ROWS, D):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be [{n_items}, {ROWS}, {D}], got {tuple(out.shape)}")
+    strides = tuple(int(s) for s in out.stride())
+    if strides[2] != 1 or (strides[0] * 2) % 16 or (strides[1] * 2) % 16 or strides[1] < D:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must have D contiguous and 16-byte-aligned item / row strides (row stride >= {D}), got {strides}")
+    if out.data_ptr() % 16:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 16-byte aligned, got data_ptr={out.data_ptr():#x}")
+    if out.device != device:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must live on {device}, got {out.device}")
+
+
+def n_units_of(n_items: int) -> int:
+    return int(n_items) * UNITS_PER_ITEM
+
+
+def n_ctas_of(n_units: int, sm_count: int) -> int:
+    """The persistent grid: the device's cap (``SMs x CTAS_PER_SM``), never more than the units, at least one."""
+    return max(1, min(int(n_units), int(sm_count) * CTAS_PER_SM))

+def run_qsa_kv_upcast(
+    r: QsaKvUpcastRecipe,
+    *,
+    k_pool: torch.Tensor,
+    v_pool: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    block_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    block_lens: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    seq_kv_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    v_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    out_k: torch.Tensor,
+    out_v: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_len_t: torch.Tensor,
+    s_q: int,
+    stream,
+) -> None:
+    """Validate the FORM of every operand (no device read) and launch (Rule 1: no conversion, no allocation).
+
+    ``block_ids``: int32 contiguous ``[B, top_k]`` under ``list_per_sequence`` (one list per sequence, the ``S_q <= 4`` rows share
+    it) or ``[B, S_q, top_k]`` per token; ``block_lens`` ``[B]`` / ``[B, S_q]`` int32 or None (its presence is the artifact's);
+    ``seq_kv_lens`` int32 ``[B]``; ``k_scale`` / ``v_scale`` 1-element fp32 CUDA tensors; ``out_k`` / ``out_v`` bf16
+    ``[B x S_q x H_kv, ROWS, D]`` (``scratch[:, 0]`` / ``scratch[:, 1]`` of :func:`scratch_shape`); ``kv_len_t`` int32
+    ``[B x S_q x H_kv]``."""

+    check_pool(k_pool, "k_pool", h_kv=r.h_kv, page_size=r.page_size, device=dev)
+    check_pool(v_pool, "v_pool", h_kv=r.h_kv, page_size=r.page_size, device=dev)
+    if int(k_pool.shape[0]) != int(v_pool.shape[0]):
+        raise ValueError(f"k_pool and v_pool must hold the same number of pages, got {int(k_pool.shape[0])} and {int(v_pool.shape[0])}")
+    s_q = int(s_q)
+    if s_q < 1 or (r.list_per_sequence and s_q > MTP_MAX_S_Q):
+        raise ValueError(f"s_q must be >= 1 (and <= {MTP_MAX_S_Q} under a shared per-sequence list), got {s_q}")
+    if not isinstance(block_table, torch.Tensor) or block_table.dim() != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"block_table must be a contiguous int32 (B, max_pages) tensor, got {getattr(block_table, 'shape', type(block_table).__name__)}")

+    if not isinstance(block_ids, torch.Tensor) or tuple(int(x) for x in block_ids.shape) not in (ids_shape, (rows, r.top_k)):
+        raise ValueError(f"block_ids must be int32 {ids_shape} (or [{rows}, {r.top_k}]), got {getattr(block_ids, 'shape', type(block_ids).__name__)}")
+    _check_i32(block_ids, "block_ids", tuple(int(x) for x in block_ids.shape), device=dev)
+    if r.has_block_lens != (block_lens is not None):
+        raise ValueError(f"this artifact was compiled {'with' if r.has_block_lens else 'without'} block_lens; the call must match (Rule 1: no silent fallback)")
+    if block_lens is not None:
+        lens_shape = (B,) if r.list_per_sequence else (B, s_q)
+        if tuple(int(x) for x in block_lens.shape) not in (lens_shape, (rows,)):
+            raise ValueError(f"block_lens must be int32 {lens_shape}, got {tuple(block_lens.shape)}")
+        _check_i32(block_lens, "block_lens", tuple(int(x) for x in block_lens.shape), device=dev)
+    for name, sc in (("k_scale", k_scale), ("v_scale", v_scale)):
+        if not isinstance(sc, torch.Tensor) or sc.dtype != torch.float32 or int(sc.numel()) != 1 or sc.device != dev:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 1-element fp32 tensor on {dev} (a device scalar, read by the kernel), got {sc!r}")
+    n_items = B * s_q * r.h_kv
+    check_out(out_k, "out_k", n_items=n_items, device=dev)
+    check_out(out_v, "out_v", n_items=n_items, device=dev)
+    _check_i32(kv_len_t, "kv_len_t", (n_items,), device=dev)
+    n_units = n_units_of(n_items)
+    n_ctas = n_ctas_of(n_units, r.sm_count)
+    r.compiled(
+        k_pool,
+        v_pool,
+        block_table,
+        block_ids.view(rows, r.top_k),  # the artifact's 2-D [rows, top_k] (a view: contiguous)
+        None if block_lens is None else block_lens.view(rows),
+        seq_kv_lens,
+        k_scale,
+        v_scale,
+        out_k,
+        out_v,
+        kv_len_t,
+        cutlass.Int32(n_units),
+        cutlass.Int32(n_ctas),
+        cutlass.Int32(s_q),
+        cuda.CUstream(int(stream)),
+    )
+

+def moved_bytes(
+    n_items: int, rows_read_total: int, *, zero_fill: str = "full", rows_written_total: Optional[int] = None, top_k: int = TOPK_MAX, max_pages: int = 0
+) -> int:
+    """The HBM traffic model of one launch for a SOL number: the gathered e4m3 rows read once per operand, the slab rows
+    written once per operand (``full``: every slab row; ``tile``: the written rows rounded up to the 128-row tile), plus the
+    lists and the table.  ``rows_read_total`` = the sum of ``kv_len_t`` over the items (host arithmetic from the caller's
+    own lists; the kernel reads nothing on the host)."""
+    rows_read_total = int(rows_read_total)
+    if zero_fill == "full":
+        written = int(n_items) * ROWS
+    else:
+        written = int(rows_written_total) if rows_written_total is not None else rows_read_total
+    return 2 * rows_read_total * D + 2 * written * D * 2 + int(n_items) * top_k * 4 + int(n_items) * max_pages * 4

+    inv = torch.reciprocal(scale.float())

+    with _no_host_sync():

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Rubin: the oracle on the dequantized pool
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _rope_tables(n_pos, dtype, ref_geom):
+    cos, sin = build_rope_tables(n_pos, ROPE, base=ref_geom.rope_base, batch=1, device=_DEV, dtype=dtype)
+    return cos, sin  # [1, n_pos, ROPE]
+
+
+class _Fp8Case:
+    """One e4m3-cache sparse DECODE step over a batch of sequences with lengths ``kv_lens`` (0 = a dead entry; a length below ``s_q``
+    leaves the rows with a negative position dead): the whole-sequence bf16 reference per entry, per-tensor DEscales calibrated on
+    the reference K / V of every live entry, the NaN-filled e4m3 pools holding the torch-quantized PREFIX rows, the block table (page
+    0 = the NULL block), the slot mapping of the step's tokens, ONE list per sequence at the step-0 position, and two fp32 oracles
+    of the step's gated O and ``out``: on the DEQUANTIZED rows (the gate) and on the pre-quantization bf16 rows (reported)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, geom_kw, s_q, kv_lens, *, page=16, layout="hnd", seed=0, top_k=512, block_lens=True, fuse_gate=False, index_band=False, n_pages=None):
+        self.s_q, self.kv_lens, self.page, self.layout, self.top_k = int(s_q), [int(x) for x in kv_lens], page, layout, top_k
+        self.block_lens_given, self.fuse_gate, self.index_band = bool(block_lens), bool(fuse_gate), bool(index_band)
+        self.geom, self.ref_geom = _geom(geom_kw, top_k=top_k, index_band=index_band)
+        geom, ref_geom, dtype = self.geom, self.ref_geom, BF16
+        self.dtype = dtype
+        h_q, h_kv, d_model = geom.h_q, geom.h_kv, geom.d_model
+        G = h_q // h_kv
+        B = len(self.kv_lens)
+        g = torch.Generator(device=_DEV).manual_seed(seed)
+        self.gen = g
+
+        def randn(*shape, std=0.02):
+            return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, device=_DEV, dtype=torch.float32) * std).to(dtype)
+
+        n_dense = sum(geom.qkvg_block_widths[:4])
+        w_qkvg = randn(geom.n_qkvg, d_model)
+        self.w = dict(
+            w_qkvg=w_qkvg, w_q_norm=torch.ones(D, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV), w_k_norm=torch.ones(D, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV), w_o=randn(d_model, h_q * D)
+        )
+        L_max = max(max(self.kv_lens), s_q)
+        cos_t, sin_t = _rope_tables(L_max, dtype, ref_geom)
+        scale = geom.scale
+        self.h = torch.zeros(B, s_q, d_model, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.cos = cos_t[0, :1].expand(s_q, ROPE).clone()[None].expand(B, s_q, ROPE).clone()
+        self.sin = sin_t[0, :1].expand(s_q, ROPE).clone()[None].expand(B, s_q, ROPE).clone()
+        self.live_rows = torch.zeros(B, s_q, dtype=torch.bool, device=_DEV)
+        refs, ids_rows, lens_rows = {}, [], []
+        for b, L in enumerate(self.kv_lens):
+            pos = torch.arange(s_q, device=_DEV) + (L - s_q)
+            live = pos >= 0
+            self.live_rows[b] = live
+            pos0 = torch.tensor([L - s_q], device=_DEV)
+            ids_b, lens_b = random_block_ids(pos0, top_k, BS, generator=g, kv_lens=torch.tensor([L], device=_DEV), shuffle=True)
+            ids_rows.append(ids_b)
+            lens_rows.append(lens_b)
+            if L == 0:
+                continue  # a dead entry: no sequence, no reference, block 0, slots -1
+            h_full = randn(1, L, d_model, std=1.0)
+            ref = gated_attention_block_reference(
+                h_full, w_qkvg[:n_dense], self.w["w_q_norm"], self.w["w_k_norm"], cos_t[:, :L], sin_t[:, :L], self.w["w_o"], ref_geom
+            )
+            refs[b] = (ref, pos, live, ids_b, lens_b)
+            p_live = pos[live]
+            self.h[b, live] = h_full[0, p_live]
+            self.cos[b, live] = cos_t[0, p_live]
+            self.sin[b, live] = sin_t[0, p_live]
+        # the per-tensor DEscales, calibrated on every live entry's whole-sequence K / V (a static serving calibration)
+        all_k = torch.cat([r[0].k[0].reshape(-1) for r in refs.values()]) if refs else torch.ones(1, device=_DEV)
+        all_v = torch.cat([r[0].v[0].reshape(-1) for r in refs.values()]) if refs else torch.ones(1, device=_DEV)
+        self.k_scale, self.v_scale = _scale_of(all_k), _scale_of(all_v)
+        # the two oracles per entry: on the DEQUANTIZED rows (prefix AND step rows through the e4m3 codes) and on the bf16 rows
+        self.ref_out = torch.zeros(B, s_q, d_model, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.ref_o_gated = torch.zeros(B, s_q, h_q, D, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.ref_o_gated_bf16 = torch.zeros(B, s_q, h_q, D, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.ref_codes = {}  # b -> (K codes [L, h_kv, D], V codes): the prefix rows go into the pools; the step rows pin the write-through
+        for b, (ref, pos, live, ids_b, lens_b) in refs.items():
+            L = self.kv_lens[b]
+            k_codes, v_codes = _quantize(ref.k[0], self.k_scale), _quantize(ref.v[0], self.v_scale)
+            self.ref_codes[b] = (k_codes, v_codes)
+            kd, vd = _dequantize(k_codes, self.k_scale), _dequantize(v_codes, self.v_scale)
+            p_live = pos[live]
+            rows = ids_b.expand(s_q, top_k)
+            lens_arg = lens_b.expand(s_q) if block_lens else None
+            allowed = qsa_visible_mask(rows, lens_arg, pos, L, L, BS, top_k=top_k, pos0=L - s_q)[live]
+            q_rows = ref.q[0][p_live].float()
+            gate_rows = ref.gate[0][p_live].float()
+            for which, (kk_all, vv_all, o_dst) in (("deq", (kd, vd, self.ref_o_gated)), ("bf16", (ref.k[0], ref.v[0], self.ref_o_gated_bf16))):
+                o = torch.zeros(int(live.sum()), h_q, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=_DEV)
+                for hh in range(h_q):
+                    kk, vv = kk_all[:, hh // G].float(), vv_all[:, hh // G].float()
+                    sc = (q_rows[:, hh] @ kk.t()) * scale
+                    sc = sc.masked_fill(~allowed, float("-inf"))
+                    rmax = sc.amax(dim=-1)
+                    dead = torch.isinf(rmax) & (rmax < 0)
+                    safe = torch.where(dead, torch.zeros_like(rmax), rmax)
+                    p = torch.where(allowed, torch.exp(sc - safe[:, None]), torch.zeros_like(sc))
+                    den = p.sum(dim=-1)
+                    den_safe = torch.where(dead, torch.ones_like(den), den)
+                    oc = (p @ vv) / den_safe[:, None]
+                    o[:, hh] = torch.where(dead[:, None], torch.zeros_like(oc), oc)
+                o16 = o.to(dtype)  # the oracle's single rounding of O, then the gate in fp32, then one rounding
+                og = (o16.float() * torch.sigmoid(gate_rows)).to(dtype)
+                o_dst[b, live] = og
+                if which == "deq":
+                    self.ref_out[b, live] = (og.reshape(-1, h_q * D).float() @ self.w["w_o"].float().t()).to(dtype)
+        self.block_ids = torch.stack([x.reshape(top_k) for x in ids_rows]).contiguous()
+        self.block_lens = torch.stack([x.reshape(()) for x in lens_rows]).contiguous()
+        assert self.block_ids.dtype == torch.int32 and self.block_lens.dtype == torch.int32
+        # pages: block 0 reserved (NULL); each live entry gets ceil(L / P) pages from a permutation of 1 .. n_pages - 1; -1 past them
+        need = sum(-(-L // page) for L in self.kv_lens)
+        self.n_pages = n_pages if n_pages is not None else need + 1 + 2
+        assert self.n_pages >= need + 1, (self.n_pages, need)
+        perm = (torch.randperm(self.n_pages - 1, generator=g, device=_DEV) + 1).tolist()
+        self.max_pages = max(-(-L_max // page), 1)
+        self.block_table = torch.full((B, self.max_pages), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEV)
+        it = iter(perm)
+        slots = torch.full((B * s_q,), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEV)
+        self.k_cache, self.v_cache = _pools(self.n_pages, h_kv, page, layout, E4M3)
+        self.index_cache = torch.full((self.n_pages, page, geom.qsa.index_head_dim), float("nan"), dtype=dtype, device=_DEV) if index_band else None
+        for b, L in enumerate(self.kv_lens):
+            if L == 0:
+                self.block_table[b] = 0  # the dead entry: the NULL block, slots -1
+                continue
+            pages = [next(it) for _ in range(-(-L // page))]
+            self.block_table[b, : len(pages)] = torch.tensor(pages, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEV)
+            k_codes, v_codes = self.ref_codes[b]
+            for p in range(max(L - s_q, 0)):  # the PREFIX: the torch-quantized codes into the pools
+                pg, off = pages[p // page], p % page
+                self.k_cache[pg, :, off] = k_codes[p]
+                self.v_cache[pg, :, off] = v_codes[p]
+            for j in range(s_q):  # the step's live tokens: written through (and quantized) by the block
+                p = L - s_q + j
+                if p >= 0:
+                    slots[b * s_q + j] = pages[p // page] * page + p % page
+        self.slot_mapping = slots
+        self.kv_lens_t = torch.tensor(self.kv_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEV)
+        self.prefix_bits = (_bits(self.k_cache).clone(), _bits(self.v_cache).clone())
+        self.blk_kw = dict(
+            paged_kv_page_size=page,
+            kv_source=KV_SOURCE_PAGED,
+            sample_k_cache=self.k_cache,
+            sample_v_cache=self.v_cache,
+            sample_block_table=self.block_table,
+            fuse_gate=fuse_gate,
+            kv_cache_dtype=E4M3,
+        )
+        self.out = torch.empty(B, s_q, d_model, dtype=dtype, device=_DEV)
+        self.blk = GatedAttentionBlockFwd(
+            self.h, self.w["w_qkvg"], self.w["w_q_norm"], self.w["w_k_norm"], self.cos, self.sin, self.w["w_o"], self.out, self.geom, **self.blk_kw
+        )
+        assert isinstance(self.blk._sdpa, _UpcastSparseSdpa) and self.blk.upcast_decode and self.blk.inplace_qkv is False and self.blk.gate_fused is False
+        self.ws = None
+
+    def compile(self):
+        assert self.blk.check_support()
+        self.blk.compile()
+        self.ws = torch.full((self.blk.get_workspace_size(),), 0x7F, dtype=torch.uint8, device=_DEV)
+        return self
+
+    def execute(
+        self,
+        *,
+        out=None,
+        ws=None,
+        h=None,
+        cos=None,
+        sin=None,
+        kv_lens=None,
+        block_table=None,
+        slot_mapping=None,
+        ids=None,
+        lens=None,
+        k_scale=None,
+        v_scale=None,
+        stream=None,
+    ):
+        out = self.out if out is None else out
+        self.blk.execute(
+            self.h if h is None else h,
+            self.w["w_qkvg"],
+            self.w["w_q_norm"],
+            self.w["w_k_norm"],
+            self.cos if cos is None else cos,
+            self.sin if sin is None else sin,
+            self.w["w_o"],
+            out,
+            self.ws if ws is None else ws,
+            block_ids=self.block_ids if ids is None else ids,
+            block_lens=(self.block_lens if lens is None else lens) if self.block_lens_given else None,
+            k_cache=self.k_cache,
+            v_cache=self.v_cache,
+            block_table=self.block_table if block_table is None else block_table,
+            kv_lens=self.kv_lens_t if kv_lens is None else kv_lens,
+            slot_mapping=self.slot_mapping if slot_mapping is None else slot_mapping,
+            index_k_raw=self.index_cache,
+            current_stream=stream,
+            k_scale=self.k_scale if k_scale is None else k_scale,
+            v_scale=self.v_scale if v_scale is None else v_scale,
+        )
+        return out
+
+    def run(self):
+        if self.ws is None:
+            self.compile()
+        self.out.fill_(_sentinel(self.dtype))
+        self.execute()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return self.out
+
+    def views(self, ws=None):
+        """The compact normed Q and K (out of place), the slab's GATE and V bands, the O slot, the slab -- what the e4m3 mode writes."""
+        ws = self.ws if ws is None else ws
+        g, lay = self.geom, self.blk._ws
+        B, S = self.blk.batch, self.blk.seq_len
+        t = B * S
+        proj = _view(ws, lay.proj, (t, g.n_qkvg), self.dtype)
+        _o_q, o_g, _o_k, o_v = g.qkvg_offsets[:4]
+        q = _view(ws, lay.q, (t, g.h_q, g.d_head), self.dtype).view(B, S, g.h_q, g.d_head)
+        k = _view(ws, lay.k, (t, g.h_kv, g.d_head), self.dtype).view(B, S, g.h_kv, g.d_head)
+        gate = _cols(proj, o_g, g.h_q, g.d_head).view(B, S, g.h_q, g.d_head)
+        v = _cols(proj, o_v, g.h_kv, g.d_head).view(B, S, g.h_kv, g.d_head)
+        o = _view(ws, lay.o, (t, g.h_q, g.d_head), self.dtype).view(B, S, g.h_q, g.d_head)

+        return f"[{self.geom.h_q}/{self.geom.h_kv} S_q={self.s_q} e4m3 p{self.page} {self.layout} gate={'fused->launch' if self.fuse_gate else 'launch'} lens={self.kv_lens}]"

+    def check(self, out=None, ws=None, *, what="out"):
+        """The standard assertions: finite, no sentinel, dead rows exact, within the budget vs the oracle on the DEQUANTIZED pool (out, the
+        gated O slot), the pools' step rows BITWISE torch's quantization of the block's own K rows and V band, the prefix rows and
+        the NULL block untouched; the distance to the bf16 oracle printed (no gate)."""
+        out = self.out if out is None else out
+        ws = self.ws if ws is None else ws
+        sent = _sentinel(self.dtype)
+        live = self.live_rows
+        dead = ~live
+        q, gate, k, v, o, proj = self.views(ws)

+            assert (out[dead] == 0).all() and (o[dead] == 0).all(), f"{what}: a dead row's out and O must be exactly 0"
+        c = _cos(out[live], self.ref_out[live])
+        d_out = float((out[live].float() - self.ref_out[live].float()).abs().max())
+        d_o = float((o[live].float() - self.ref_o_gated[live].float()).abs().max())
+        d_o_bf16 = float((o[live].float() - self.ref_o_gated_bf16[live].float()).abs().max())
+        assert c > COS_OUT, f"{what}: cos(out) {c} <= {COS_OUT}"
+        assert d_o <= ATOL, f"{what}: gated O off the oracle on the dequantized pool by {d_o} (budget {ATOL})"
+        # the quantizing write-through: the step's live rows are torch's e4m3 codes of the block's own normed K rows / V band, bitwise
+        slot = self.slot_mapping
+        lv = slot >= 0
+        s_ = slot[lv].long()
+        kf, vf = k.reshape(-1, self.geom.h_kv, D), v.reshape(-1, self.geom.h_kv, D)
+        assert torch.equal(
+            _bits(self.k_cache[s_ // self.page, :, s_ % self.page, :]), _bits(_quantize(kf[lv], self.k_scale))
+        ), f"{what}: the K pool rows are not the quantized K rows"
+        assert torch.equal(
+            _bits(self.v_cache[s_ // self.page, :, s_ % self.page, :]), _bits(_quantize(vf[lv], self.v_scale))
+        ), f"{what}: the V pool rows are not the quantized V rows"
+        for pool, before in zip((self.k_cache, self.v_cache), self.prefix_bits):
+            now = _bits(pool)
+            touched = (now != before).any(dim=-1).any(dim=1)  # [n_pages, page] rows whose bits moved
+            rows_moved = touched.nonzero()
+            written = set((int(p) for p in (s_ // self.page * self.page + s_ % self.page).tolist()))
+            assert all(int(pg) * self.page + int(off) in written for pg, off in rows_moved), f"{what}: a pool row outside the step's slots moved"
+            assert not touched[0].any(), f"{what}: the NULL block moved"
+        if self.index_cache is not None:
+            raw = index_k_raw_view(proj, self.geom, self.blk.batch, self.blk.seq_len)  # [B, S, 1, index_head_dim]
+            assert torch.equal(_bits(self.index_cache[s_ // self.page, s_ % self.page, :]), _bits(raw.reshape(-1, raw.shape[-1])[lv]))
+            assert (~torch.isnan(self.index_cache.float())).all(-1).sum().item() == int(lv.sum())
+        print(
+            f"\n{self.label()} {what}: cos(out) {c:.6f} max|d out| {d_out:.4e} max|d O_gated| vs the DEQUANTIZED oracle {d_o:.4e} (budget {ATOL}); "
+            f"vs the PRE-quantization bf16 oracle {d_o_bf16:.4e} (reported, no gate); dead rows {int(dead.sum())}; k_scale {float(self.k_scale):.4e} v_scale {float(self.v_scale):.4e}"
+        )
+        return dict(cos=c, d_out=d_out, d_o=d_o, d_o_bf16=d_o_bf16, dead=int(dead.sum()))

+def _stream():

+def _quantize(x: torch.Tensor):
+    """Per-tensor e4m3 quantization of a bf16 ``[B, S, H_kv, D]`` tensor: ``(pool, dequantized bf16, scale fp32 [1])`` with the
+    dequantized values EXACTLY the cast kernel's ``bf16(fp32(e4m3) * scale)``."""
+    amax = x.float().abs().amax().clamp_min(1e-12)
+    scale = (amax / 448.0).reshape(1).to(torch.float32)
+    pool = (x.float() / scale).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    deq = (pool.float() * scale).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    return pool, deq, scale.contiguous()

+def _paginate(pools, kv_lens, P, hnd, gen, *, dead_pages=()):
+    """Scatter the first ``kv_lens[b]`` tokens of every ``[B, SKV, H_kv, D]`` e4m3 tensor in ``pools`` into ``[num_pages, H_kv, P, D]``
+    pools (HND, or NHD storage permuted into that view) through ONE shuffled int32 table (the kernel takes one table for K and V);
+    every unwritten row holds NaN (a gathered unwritten row poisons the output); table entries past a sequence's live pages are
+    -1; ``dead_pages`` = ``(b, p)`` LIVE pages whose table entry is set to -1 (the kernel reads them as ZERO rows that still count).
+    Returns ``(views, table)``."""
+    B, SKV, KH, _ = pools[0].shape
+    dev = pools[0].device
+    max_pages = -(-SKV // P)
+    num_pages = B * max_pages + 3
+    shape = (num_pages, KH, P, D) if hnd else (num_pages, P, KH, D)
+    perm = torch.randperm(num_pages, device=dev, generator=gen)[: B * max_pages].view(B, max_pages)
+    table = perm.to(torch.int32).clone()
+    views = []
+    for pool_dense in pools:
+        pool = torch.full(shape, float("nan"), device=dev, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        for b in range(B):
+            L = int(kv_lens[b])
+            n_live = -(-L // P)
+            for p in range(max_pages):
+                if p >= n_live:
+                    continue
+                t0, t1 = p * P, min((p + 1) * P, L)
+                rows = pool_dense[b, t0:t1]  # [t1 - t0, KH, D]
+                page = int(perm[b, p])
+                if hnd:
+                    pool[page, :, : t1 - t0] = rows.permute(1, 0, 2)
+                else:
+                    pool[page, : t1 - t0] = rows
+        views.append(pool if hnd else pool.permute(0, 2, 1, 3))
+    for b in range(B):
+        n_live = -(-int(kv_lens[b]) // P)
+        table[b, n_live:] = -1
+    for b, p in dead_pages:
+        table[b, p] = -1
+    return views, table.contiguous()
+

+def _lists(B, S_q, top_k, kv_lens, gen, *, per_token, degenerate=True):
+    """Random lists (the oracle's builder): shared ``[B, top_k]`` anchored at the step-0 position, or per-token ``[B, S_q,
+    top_k]`` at every row's own position; with ``degenerate``, entry 2 of every row with >= 8 entries is set to -1 and entry 5
+    to an id far past any visible range -- both must contribute nothing."""
+    dev = torch.device("cuda")
+    kvl = torch.tensor(kv_lens, device=dev, dtype=torch.long)
+    if per_token:
+        pos = (kvl[:, None] - S_q) + torch.arange(S_q, device=dev)[None, :]
+        ids, lens = random_block_ids(pos, top_k, BS, generator=gen, kv_lens=kvl[:, None].expand(B, S_q), shuffle=True)
+    else:
+        ids, lens = random_block_ids(kvl - S_q, top_k, BS, generator=gen, kv_lens=kvl, shuffle=True)
+    ids, lens = ids.contiguous(), lens.contiguous()
+    if degenerate:
+        flat_ids, flat_lens = ids.view(-1, top_k), lens.view(-1)
+        for r in range(flat_ids.shape[0]):
+            if int(flat_lens[r]) >= 8:
+                flat_ids[r, 2] = -1
+                flat_ids[r, 5] = 1 << 20
+    return ids, lens

+def _expected_rows(ids_row, count, n_vis, n_anchor):
+    """The compaction contract on the host: the listed blocks' visible rows in list order, then the open tail."""
+    rows = []
+    n_blk_vis = (n_vis + BS - 1) // BS
+    for i in range(count):
+        blk = int(ids_row[i])
+        if 0 <= blk < n_blk_vis:
+            rows.extend(range(BS * blk, min(BS * blk + BS, n_vis)))
+    rows.extend(range(BS * (n_anchor // BS), n_vis))
+    return rows
+

+def _item_geometry(b, s, S_q, L, lens_row, top_k, per_token):
+    pos = L - S_q + s
+    anchor = pos if per_token else L - S_q
+    n_vis = max(min(pos + 1, L), 0)
+    n_anchor = max(min(anchor + 1, L), 0)
+    n_sel = min(top_k, n_anchor // BS)
+    count = n_sel if lens_row is None else min(max(int(lens_row), 0), n_sel)
+    return n_vis, n_anchor, count

+def _run_cast(k_pool, v_pool, table, ids, lens, kv_lens, k_scale, v_scale, *, B, S_q, top_k, P, per_token, zero_fill="full", launches=2):

+    ``(scratch, kv_len_t)``."""

+    seq_kv = torch.tensor(kv_lens, device=dev, dtype=torch.int32)

+    for _ in range(launches):

+        kv_len_t = torch.full((n_items,), -7, device=dev, dtype=torch.int32)
+        upcast.run_qsa_kv_upcast(
+            r,
+            k_pool=k_pool,
+            v_pool=v_pool,
+            block_table=table,
+            block_ids=ids,
+            block_lens=lens,
+            seq_kv_lens=seq_kv,
+            k_scale=k_scale,
+            v_scale=v_scale,
+            out_k=scratch[:, 0],
+            out_v=scratch[:, 1],
+            kv_len_t=kv_len_t,
+            s_q=S_q,
+            stream=_stream(),
